panels.title: Time left
panels.description: At the rate of the last 5 minutes, for the bytes the run plans to write.

panels.title: Wrong answers
panels.description: Reads that failed verification. Any is a failed run: see failures.jsonl.

panels.title: Write amp
panels.description: SST bytes uploaded by the writer and maintenance per key and value byte written, first save included.

panels.title: Space amp
panels.description: SST bytes in the bucket per byte the database holds, from the last listing.

panels.title: Writes held
panels.description: 1 while the disk guard holds new writes because the disk is too full.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing now; Prometheus lists them all at /alerts.

panels.title: Write answers per second
panels.description: committed; refused (503), nothing written; not_committed, never saved; unknown, asked about; unresolved, sent again.

panels.title: Commit latency, as the client sees it
Writer save time
panels.description: How long the writer takes to save a group of writes to storage.

panels.title: Writer backpressure
panels.description: Writes per second the writer refused because too much data was waiting to be saved.

panels.title: Oldest write waiting to be saved
panels.description: How long the oldest accepted write has waited to be saved; 0 when nothing waits. Rising: saves are stalling.

panels.title: Writer merge outcomes
panels.description: Combined files per second: published in place of the saves they came from, refused by maintenance, dropped because maintenance took the files first, or failed. Skipped bytes: saves not held to combine, the memory being full.

panels.title: Read latency, as the client sees it
Age of the data readers serve
Reader refresh failures
panels.description: Failed loads of new data per second, and reads answered from old data while loading failed.

panels.title: Reader refresh time
panels.description: How long loading new data takes; slow loads are the usual reason the data served is old.

panels.title: Reader errors
panels.description: Per second, all readers. Filter skips: key reads that checked a file without its filter, because it failed to load.

panels.title: Reader storage reads
panels.description: Reads of data files from storage per second, all readers, and the bytes they fetched.

panels.title: Storage bytes per client read
panels.description: Bytes the readers fetched from storage for each get or scan the harness made. Grows as reads check more files.

panels.title: Checks waiting for their revision to settle
Finished work waiting for the writer
panels.description: Published: from when maintenance handed over finished work to when the writer published it, as the writer measured it. Publishing: the writer's own time to publish it. Unanswered now: how long the work maintenance is waiting on has waited, as maintenance last saw it; it clears when maintenance's next round starts, so it rising past a few minutes means no writer is answering. Empty for versions that don't export them.

panels.title: L0 files and depth
panels.description: New files not yet merged into L1, and the most of them one key is in. Growing without stopping: compaction can't keep up. Empty for versions that don't export it.

panels.title: Compaction urgent
panels.description: 1 while the compaction running is urgent because L0 is too deep.

panels.title: Level fill (bytes / target)
panels.description: Above 100% the level waits to be merged down; far above, every merge into it costs more.

panels.title: Compaction time, by kind
panels.description: Jobs hold the single compaction slot for this long.

panels.title: Level files
panels.description: Files in each level below L0. A job takes at most 128 files, so many small files make each job cover less.

panels.title: Deleted per second, by kind
panels.description: Objects maintenance removed from storage. If deletes fall behind, the bucket grows: see space amplification.

panels.title: Maintenance errors per minute
panels.description: Rounds of maintenance work that failed and are retried, and levels due for compaction that no job could be planned for. Levels waiting their turn are not counted. Blocked is empty for versions that don't export it.

panels.title: Uploaded per second, by proxy and kind
Requests per second, by proxy and method
SILO CPU (cores)
panels.description: Compare with SILO_CPUS: near it, SILO is the bottleneck.

panels.title: SILO requests per second, by call
SILO requests in flight and waiting
Host CPU
panels.description: The whole host, as SILO sees it.
